name: Memories ~Kioku no Subete o...~
source:
In the facility called “Farm” main character is allowed by his father to have one girl who he calls La Nina. Girl's actual name is Make. She is a cheerful girl who very soon becomes protagonist's friend and then lover. But when he tries to ask her about the meaning of "La Nina" name, she suddenly falls in the state of shock and only whispers about her "fate".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在名为“Farm”的设施里，主人公获父亲允许拥有一名被他称为“La Nina”的少女。少女真正的名字是真希，性格开朗，很快便与主人公从朋友发展成恋人。可是，当主人公询问“La Nina”这个称呼有何含义时，她突然陷入休克，只低声呢喃着自己的“命运”。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
